thread:
marta: Heads up — preemptible churn in us-west1 creeping up since ~02:00 UTC, eviction rate up ~2.4x vs baseline. Not a single big spike but steady drift. Seeing increased warm->cold transitions on mixed pools.

sam: Thanks — are these all GPU types or mixed accelerators? any pattern by instance family?

marta: Mostly A100 and T4 slices, a few newer A10g. It looks correlated with a new zone-level autoscaler behavior (cloud side).

jia: ops-bot just flagged a ramp:
ops-bot: [alert] preemptible_eviction_rate(us-west1) > 1.8x for 30m — routed to #eng-infra.

leo: Two quick asks: 1) can we run a short redispatch for low-priority requests into warm soft-buckets (ttl 90s) to reduce cold starts? 2) should we start routing some latency-tolerant customers to multi-region fallback immediately?

marta: Proposal: activate a staged redispatch play for tier=spot-soft (new bucket) that does: 
- keep a small hot set pinned per zone for high-QPS keys
- redirect tier=free/trial to quantized model variant with lower GPU footprint
- any request hitting eviction > 5% within 30s gets spill to other region or to delayed-batch queue

nina: How do we avoid thundering-herd when many sessions spill? last time fallback caused regional saturation.

sam: We should add exponential backoff + jitter on redispatch and a per-customer spill cap. Also use token-based admission: if warm-bucket has <threshold tokens, start shedding to delayed-batch.

jia: Config snippet for the soft-bucket feature flag (beta):
```json
{
  "soft_bucket": true,
  "ttl_seconds": 90,
  "spill_policy": "regional-first",
  "spill_threshold_pct": 5,
  "per_customer_spill_cap": 0.15
}
```

marta: + add a probe-runner that pings quantized variant for 10% of trial traffic to watch quality. we need eval hooks to detect regressions early.

leo: For routing rules: prefer same-region warm-buckets, else partner-region (if latency < 200ms), else quantized-local. keep a fallback chain. Also add quick metric: "spill_latency_99" to watch for tail cost.

nina: Ops concerns: make sure billing tags remain accurate (we don't want to hide cost shifts into dedicated buckets). Add a cost tag on redistributed requests.

sam: Implementation plan:
- step 1 (30m): enable monitoring alert for drift + construct soft_bucket flag (config-only)
- step 2 (1h): turn on redispatch with per-customer cap and backoff in Canary region (us-west1-a)
- step 3 (3h): if canary looks good, roll to us-west1 full region, then us-west2 fallback
- step 4 (24h): enable quantized fallback for trial tiers if quality delta < 1% on eval set

marta: Runbook notes: if spill_latency_99 > 250ms AND eviction_rate > 3x -> pause redispatch and force regional failover to dedicated pool for high-tier customers only.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started build #rwd-softbucket-v1 -> logs: linking...

jia: I'll add the eval hooks and a quick dashboard. Sam can you wire the per-customer token limiter?

sam: On it — ETA 2h for limiter + 1h for integration tests.

marta: Thanks all. If we see continued drift overnight we'll flip the feature-flag to green and run canary tomorrow morning @sam @jia.

leo: FYI I'll prepare a note for product about potential quality trade-offs vs cost for trial customers.

nina: Adding incident page stub under infra runbook with rollback steps.

marta: closing thread for now — will update in the morning with telemetry snapshot. :seedling:
